name: Tét (Hungary)
description: White field with a fly panel of blue and red triangles, charged at the centre of the white with the town arms of Tét: a crowned quartered blue and red shield with tools and a sabre, above a yellow scroll inscribed TÉT.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tét arms with crown and scroll
